changelog.message: op created for native Swift-backed global keyboard telemetry
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Streams system-wide global real-time keyboard inputs, key presses, modifier flag states, and key combos (e.g. 'ctrl + shift + a') via WebSockets from the native macOS backend daemon.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable global keyboard telemetry listening.

ports.name: Hostname
ports.text: Interface where the Swift server is running (default 127.0.0.1).

ports.name: Port
ports.text: Port where the Swift server is listening (default 8080).

ports.name: On Press
ports.text: Fires when any global key press event is captured.

ports.name: On Release
ports.text: Fires when any global key release event is captured.

ports.name: Combo
ports.text: The complete modifier plus key combination string (e.g. 'ctrl + alt + delete').

ports.name: Modifiers
ports.text: The active modifier string at the time of key action (e.g. 'ctrl + alt').
